title: Juncheng Zhang | 张俊成
text: I am a PhD Candidate in Economics at the University of Nottingham Ningbo China and a member of Centre for Decision Research and Experimental Economics (CeDEx) China. I received my Master’s degree from University of Southampton and my Bachelor’s degree from Jilin University, Zhuhai College. My research interests span labour economics, experimental economics, and behavioural economics, with a particular focus on how self-perception shapes individual decision-making.

title: Call For Research Assistant (Open until filled)
text:
We are recruiting undergraduate Research Assistants (RAs) to support research projects in Labour Economics, Educational Economics, and Network Economics. The project will run from September to December 2026, and the main RA responsibilities will involve data collection and data cleaning. The project is led by Dr. Stuart McDonald from the School of Economics, University of Nottingham Ningbo China.
As the project requires continuous collaboration over the semester, regular and reliable time commitment throughout the project period is particularly important to us. Before applying, please consider your academic schedule and any other commitments that may affect your availability between September and December 2026.
Shortlisted applicants may be invited to a brief interview.
We greatly appreciate your interest in our research and look forward to learning more about you.

title: Research
text: My research focuses on experimental and behavioural economics and decision theory, with a particular interest in how self-perception influences economic decision-making in labour market and search environments. My research primarily employs experimental methods to test theoretical predictions and study individual behaviour, while I also conduct empirical research on related topics.
